Hi Liam — thanks for sending these over and for the clear summary. Looping in Marissa (procurement) and David (finance ops) to make sure we capture vendor classification and PO timing.

A few notes / asks from our side:
1) We need the completed onboarding PDF (you attached a fillable copy — thanks). Please confirm the bank remit instructions are on the W-9 or a separate remittance addendum.
2) Redwood's standard for new vendors is Net30. We do, however, have several ways to accommodate different cycles:
   - Grant Net45 for tiered partners on a case-by-case basis (requires procurement approval)
   - Enrollment in our accelerated remit pilot (early-pay) — typical market options are 1% fee for payment within 7-10 days, or scaled tiers (0.5% for 15 days) depending on volume
3) Can you confirm the PO routing contact (who at Avalon receives the PO and who validates invoice matching)? We need a named contact + email to place in the vendor record.

If you can confirm bank remit + PO contact, we'll start the vendor record and aim to issue a PO within ~72 business hours once procurement has signed off. If procurement approves Net45, we'll note that on the PO; otherwise we'll provision Net30 and flag you for accelerated-pay options.

Thanks — I will follow up once Marissa confirms classification.

Chloe Martin

Hi all — thanks for the packet, Liam. A couple of procurement items to close so we can activate the vendor:

1) Supplier classification: please confirm whether Avalon should be set up as "Services - Professional" or "Services - Facilities" (affects tax withholding/1099 tags).
2) Remittance/bank details: W-9 is great; please send a remittance addendum or confirm bank ACH details. We store only masked banking info in the vendor record and request a separate remittance form for security.
3) PO activation timing: once we have the completed onboarding form, W-9, remittance addendum, and a named PO recipient, procurement typically provisions the vendor record and issues a PO within 48-72 business hours.
4) Payment terms & PO matching: Redwood enforces PO matching — invoices must reference the PO# and have line-item matches. Invoices should be sent to invoices@redwood-inference.com and include the PO # in the subject line for automated routing.

Net45 requests are handled by procurement leadership. If Avalon prefers Net45, we will escalate for approval — our default is Net30. If you want the accelerated-pay option, please indicate the fee and target payment window and we will route that to Finance for evaluation.

Once you send the remittance addendum and confirm supplier classification, I will kick off the PO.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
